intent.subtype: wildcard comparison against an operand supplied by an input port
intent.rationale: data_in ==? idle_pat treats X or Z bits of the right operand as wildcards; whether idle_pat can carry X/Z is not decidable from the file.

labels.note: ==? with a non-constant right side treats X/Z bits of idle_pat as wildcards in simulation only; whether that happens depends on the run-time value.
==? with a non-constant right operand treats X/Z bits of idle_pat as wildcards in simulation only (Verilator rejects it as unsupported).

settlement.note: ==? with the non-constant right operand idle_pat treats its X/Z bits as wildcards in simulation only; no X or Z is written in the design, so the outcome depends on values of an unconstrained input port.
